title: Ancient ruins conceal Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji held the third page fragment, falling into deep thought: 'Tianji Record... what exactly are you?' The owner of that sinister laughter is waiting in the depths, and with his Heavenly Fate Value nearly exhausted, he must make a choice between truth and survival.

text.content: The sinister laughter echoed like a demon's whisper through the ruins' depths. Chen Ji stood still, the gleam in his eyes flickering briefly. The Heavenly Fate Value at his brow center throbbed with pain—only seven points remaining, leaving no room for waste. He didn't rush forward, instead extending his divine sense like silk threads toward the source of that laughter. The spiritual energy in the air suddenly turned violent, as countless fine needles pierced into his Mental Sea. A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips. Trash? Hmph, trash wouldn't dare probe a forbidden land.

The moment his divine sense probed inward, a blurry image flashed through his mind—the deepest part of the ruins, a stone platform covered in runes, with a yellowed scroll floating above it. The vision lasted only three breaths before shattering and vanishing, but Chen Ji had already seen the key detail: the stone platform was surrounded by formation patterns, and those patterns... matched the fragmented designs on the Tianji Record's cover exactly. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: 'Little friend, this formation I recognize. It was set up during ancient times specifically to seal Heavenly Secrets Arts. If this old man is not mistaken, Chen Xuan大人的遗迹便在前方。'

dialogue.content: That laughter...' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare hint of solemnity. 'Little friend, act carefully. The things sealed within these ruins are probably not as simple as just the Tianji Record. This old man faintly senses a familiar aura—that is... another remnant soul.

text.content: Chen Ji's steps faltered, a gleam flickering in his eyes. Another remnant soul? Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned this. He didn't press for answers, merely filing this debt away in silence. The benefit of being trash is that no one guards against your lies, nor guards against your grudges. Chen Ji took a deep breath, drawing a dim talisman from his chest—his last trump card. Once activated, it grants three breaths of immunity to all attacks. Three breaths are enough. He stepped into the dark passage, spiritual flames flickering at his fingertips, illuminating the mottled stone walls on both sides.

The passage grew narrower with each step, while the runes on the stone walls grew denser. Those runes emitted a ghostly blue glow, flickering like breathing. Chen Ji noticed a detail: the arrangement of these runes perfectly matched the nearly worn-away patterns along the edges of the Tianji Record's first page. His heart couldn't help but quicken. Chen Xuan... what exactly did you leave in these ruins? A stone door appeared ahead, carved with four ancient characters—'Heavenly Secrets Treasury'. Chen Ji reached out to touch the stone door, and the moment his fingertips made contact, a torrent of information flooded into his Mental Sea like a flood.

Intense pain wracked his Mental Sea. Chen Ji let out a muffled groan, nearly falling to his knees. But gritting his teeth, he endured the information assault. Images rapidly flashed before his eyes—he saw a green-robed man standing before the same stone door, his features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji himself, though his temperament was far more flamboyant and unbridled. That man was Chen Xuan, the creator of the Tianji Record, and his nominal ancestor. Chen Xuan had laid numerous formations before the stone door, sealing a scroll fragment within, then turned and left with resolute steps. Before departing, he looked back at the stone door, murmuring something.

dialogue.content: 'So that's how it is.' Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, a complex light flickering within. He finally understood the purpose of these ruins' existence—this was no treasure vault, but the final trial Chen Xuan had left for his inheritor. The formations on the stone door slowly dissipated, as if sensing the aura of the Tianji Record. 'Mo Xiansheng,' Chen Ji spoke, his voice eerily calm, 'the other remnant soul you mentioned earlier... was it Chen Xuan himself?' Silence filled the Mental Sea before Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged once more, carrying a hint of vicissitude: 'Little friend, some matters, when the time is not yet right, this old man dare not speak much. But this old man can tell you one thing—Chen Xuan never truly perished. He has been waiting.'

text.content: The stone door crashed open, a gust of spiritual energy that had lain dormant for countless ages rushed forth. Chen Ji crossed the threshold, and the scene before him made his pupils constrict—this was a massive underground stone chamber, its walls covered in dense formation patterns, with a nine-tiered altar standing at the center. At the very top of the altar, a yellowed scroll floated mid-air, emanating a soft glow. And beneath that scroll, a phantom figure sat cross-legged, features blurred, yet one could clearly feel its gaze resting upon Chen Ji.

'You've arrived.' The phantom spoke, its voice aged yet full of vitality, entirely different from that sinister laughter from before. Chen Ji offered no reply, merely gazing quietly at the phantom. The Heavenly Fate Value at his brow center faintly pulsed. 'No need to be tense,' the phantom seemed to smile, 'this old man has waited three hundred years for this day. Three hundred years ago, this old man attained nirvana here, leaving only a remnant soul to guard this object, waiting for someone destined.' With that, he raised his hand to point at the floating scroll. 'That is the third page of the Tianji Record, also the final page. Take it, and you shall know the complete truth of the Tianji Record.'

dialogue.content: 'The price?' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm—he never believed in free lunches. Three hundred years of waiting, three hundred years of guarding, this very determination spoke volumes. 'The price?' The phantom fell silent for a moment. 'Boy, you are indeed cautious. No wonder you're the one who could make it here. The price is—that you must accept the true mission of the Tianji Record.' Chen Ji furrowed his brow slightly: 'What mission?' The phantom slowly rose, its illusory form casting eerie shadows within the stone chamber: 'The Tianji Record is not some prophetic divine artifact. Its true purpose is to break the shackles Heaven has imposed upon the human race. All those visions and prophecies you've witnessed are merely surface phenomena. The true Tianji Record is a key—a key that can unlock the cage of Heaven.'

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, but his fingers tightened slightly. Heavenly Eye... Mo Xiansheng had mentioned this existence before. Could there truly be some connection between the Tianji Record and that ultimate antagonist? 'You're doubting.' The phantom seemed to read his thoughts. 'Doubting the truth of what this old man says.' Chen Ji remained silent. 'Very well,' the phantom sighed, 'this old man knows his words carry no weight without proof. But recorded within this third page is the truth of when the Tianji Record was first created. Simply probe it with your divine sense, and you shall know all.' The scroll slowly drifted toward Chen Ji, hovering before him, within arm's reach.

choice.prompt: Faced with Chen Xuan remnant soul's revelation and the third page fragment floating before him, Chen Ji must make a choice—this may be the crucial step to change his fate, or possibly a lethal trap.

choices.description: Choose to trust Chen Xuan remnant soul's words, directly accept the third page fragment, and explore the true mission of the Tianji Record and the truth of breaking Heaven's shackles.
choices.visible_cost: May be exposed to unknown risks
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the third page of the Tianji Record, unlock complete Heavenly Secrets Arts
choices.risk_hint: The authenticity of Chen Xuan remnant soul remains unverified

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, finally reaching out his hand, divine sense probing toward that scroll. 'I choose to trust.' His voice was soft, yet carried a sense of resolve. The fragment suddenly blazed with dazzling light, countless images flickering through his Mental Sea like a kaleidoscope—Chen Xuan's original intention in creating the Tianji Record, the tragic fates of prophetic seers throughout the ages, and that terrifying existence looming over the heavens. Meanwhile, intense pain shot through Chen Ji's brow center as five more points of Heavenly Fate Value were drained. But he did not retreat; instead, he actively delved his divine sense deeper into the fragment's core.

choices.description: Do not blindly trust Chen Xuan remnant soul's words, continue maintaining the trash persona, probe the remnant soul's true intentions, seek more clues before deciding.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to obtain the third page
choices.visible_reward: Preserve current Heavenly Fate Value, maintain disguise,争取更多信息

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, his face assuming his usual cowardly expression: 'T-This junior finds the senior's words hard to accept for now. This third page... how could this junior possibly deserve it?' The phantom fell silent, and upon that blurred face seemed to emerge a playful smile. 'Interesting.' The phantom's voice changed, taking on a hint of Chen Xuan's characteristic arrogance. 'Three hundred years, and finally someone who doesn't seem like a fool. Very well, since it is a trial, let me show you the other side of truth.' The phantom flicked his sleeve, and the formation patterns on the altar suddenly blazed to life, countless images materializing in the air—prophetic seers controlled by the Heavenly Eye throughout history, the cycles of the Tianji Record shattering and reforming again and again.

text.content: Chen Ji did not act rashly; instead, he quietly probed his divine sense into the Tianji Record fragment in his arms. His brow center throbbed with pain as another five points of Heavenly Fate Value drained away. After a moment, he saw a blurry image—the remnant soul reaching out to touch his brow center, a gentle force flowing into his body, replenishing the consumed Heavenly Fate Value. 'Saw your prophecy?' The remnant soul's voice carried a hint of a smile. 'Boy, you are more cautious than this old man imagined. Good.' Chen Ji's pupils slightly dilated. His prophecy had actually been anticipated by the other party? Who exactly was this remnant soul? 'No need for surprise,' the remnant soul seemed to read his thoughts. 'The Tianji Record was created by this old man itself. Every prophecy you make, this old man can perceive.'

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in the Mental Sea, carrying a rare excitement: 'Little friend, this old man remembers! This is the【Tianji Reunion Formation】left by Chen Xuan! It can complete any incomplete thing! The third page... the Tianji Record is finally going to be complete!' Chen Ji offered no reply, merely gazing quietly at that scroll fragment resonating with the Tianji Record in his arms. The air between the two fragments began to distort, a profound aura permeating the surroundings. Meanwhile, a voice emerged in his mind—Chen Xuan's voice, carrying three hundred years of vicissitude and anticipation: 'The Tianji Record was always meant to be a key to break Heaven, not a shackle. Generations of prophetic seers were blinded by Heaven, viewing their foresight as a curse, never knowing the true mission was to—break the firmament and reclaim the fate belonging to humanity.'

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, allowing that force to flow into his body. The fragment and the Tianji Record slowly merged, transforming into a stream of light that entered his brow center. In an instant, countless images exploded within his Mental Sea—he saw the true form of the Heavenly Eye, a giant eye covering the heavens, its pupil reflecting the fates of countless humans; he saw the struggles and despair of prophetic seers throughout the ages, their struggles merely specks of dust within that giant eye; he also saw Chen Xuan, that spirited man standing beneath the Heavenly Eye, holding the complete Tianji Record, challenging the heavens alone. The image finally froze at the moment of Chen Xuan's dissipation, as he turned to gaze into the void, a relieved smile on his lips: 'Successor, the complete truth of the Tianji Record, I leave to you.'

The light within the stone chamber gradually faded. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. In his hand lay the complete Tianji Record, three pages unified, the fragmented patterns on the cover now complete, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura. His brow center felt a strange sensation—the feeling of the Tianji Record completely fusing with his divine sense, and also the sensation of fate's shackles loosening. 'Little friend,' Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, carrying a complex tone, 'the Tianji Record is complete, this old man can tell you more truths now. But the time is not yet right.' Chen Ji nodded, storing the Tianji Record in his chest. He turned to gaze at the phantom figure—Chen Xuan's remnant soul was slowly dissipating, a relieved smile on his face: 'Go. The Heavenly Eye will not sit idle. You have only three months.'

The remnant soul completely dissipated, leaving only Chen Ji alone in the stone chamber. He stood in place, gazing down at the Tianji Record in his palm, a meaningful smile curling at his lips. Three months... Hmph, though time is tight, it is enough. The secrets of the Tianji Record, the truth of the Heavenly Eye, Chen Nian's whereabouts... all clues point in the same direction. Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze穿透石室，望向远方. Trash? Never was. He simply had the habit of hiding his claws. Now, it was time to bare them. He strode out of the stone chamber. The owner of that sinister laughter still waited in the depths. But this time, Chen Ji felt no fear. Because he already knew what the Tianji Record truly was—it was not a shackle, but the key to the cage. What he had to do was break that cage, and let the Heavenly Eye witness what humanity's fury looks like.
